about: Mood and broad genre for each song on John's Song of the Day. To correct one, change its mood or genres and set moodFrom or genreFrom to "John"; a rebuild keeps those. Moods come from energy and positivity (0 to 1): Upbeat = energetic and positive, Mellow = calm and positive, Wistful = calm and sad, Brooding = energetic and dark. dance = danceability of 0.7 or more.
